events.input: $ grep -in "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; echo "---"; git ls-files | grep -ci "unipile-account-id-regex--f7ef"; git push -q origin main 2>&1 | tail -3; git status -sb | head -1
